paragraphs: Fort Orange Press is a printing and mailing company, family-owned and operated since 1905. It handles the production, printing, and mailing of essential documents for federal, state, county, and local governments. Election ballot printing and mailing services are a central part of that work.

Services run from planning, design, printing, and variable data-processing through inserting, finishing, fulfillment, mailing, shipping, tracking, and reporting. For elections, the company has developed tools that can better format and prepare voter databases. Printing and inserting pass through a security crosscheck system that uses barcodes and multiple cameras to match all components of the ballot package. A proprietary reporting platform gives clients real-time production and USPS tracking data. That platform also lets voters look up and track their ballot through the mail stream.

Beyond ballots, government agencies order property tax statements, appraisal notices, utility bills, and business licenses. Work is produced from a manufacturing facility in Albany, NY. The company calls itself a proud union shop. It also describes itself as a second-generation business. It states that it is SOC 2 Type II compliant, tested annually. Since 2012 it has held a G7 Master Qualified status for proofing and press equipment.

quote.text: Partner with states to uphold Democracy by ensuring that every ballot is printed and mailed according to the highest standards of accuracy, security and transparency.
